translit:
Sarang rag shiromani | granth shiromani dhol ||
bhagat shiromani Jivana | pragate Brijke gval ||64||
Sarang rag shiromani | ved shiromani Shyam ||
Krishna shiromani Radhika | je pragati Gokul gam ||65||

|| Sakhi bhetki ||

Bamb bahro Jivana | dole sare na kaj ||
chakve das Kabirji | ke Padmanabhko raj ||66||

|| Sakhi Shri Mukhki ||

Devhutikun Jivana | bhaye Kapil muni avtar ||
Dattatray Yadukun bhaye | Padmanabh dhanraj ||67||
Ap apana liya olakhi | Padmanabh dhanraj ||
swami sevak mali Jivana | kiyo bhaktanko kaj ||68||
Main kshir samudraman Jivana | man mero Gokul manhi ||
bhakt viyog dukhiyo bhayo | uhan jan to ave nahin ||69||
Main kshir samudraman Jivana | bohotek rahu udas ||
Vrindavanki kunjman | Radha sang vilas ||70||
Main balihari ta narki | je bolayo Gokul manhi ||
bansibat jyun Jivana | tyun bat patra to nahin ||71||
Vrindavanman Jivana | pat pat Raghuvir ||
bohotek din bhukhyo rahyo | ayo Kalindi tir ||72||
Main Ayodhyamen Jivana | man mero Gokul manhi ||
rishi patnisun kol hai | ve birad visarat nahin ||73||
Ayodhya ujad kari | ayo Gokul gamde ||
so sain hamare Jivana | Ravan maryo Ramde ||74||
Ek anant hoy vistaro | bhagat het Raghuvir ||
bohotek din bhukhyo rahyo | ayo Kalindi tir ||75||
Ek anant hoy vistaro | bhagat het Raghuvir ||
prem badhayo Jivana | Kalindiki tir ||76||
Ab aisi karun Jivana | sant vachan praman ||
nishkalank hoy ke avtarun | odharva chare khan ||77||

|| Sakhi bhetki ||

Shahapare sant seviye | nirakar nam adhar ||
bhagat het Jivana | Raghupati lino avtar ||78||

|| Sakhi Shri Mukhki ||

Raghukul Yadukul Jivana | Sita var Radha kant ||
so sain hamare shir khada | jake nam anant ||79||
Sitapati Raghunath tyaj | auranka leu nam ||
an karma kaha Jivana | jo narak na deve tham ||80||
Shir sadke karun Jivana | jahan sainka lal ||
guno bagse jivka | palmen kare nihal ||81||
Paindame pad Jivana | jahan nikse Harike das ||
sang rahe ke le chale | pure manki ash ||82||
Nejo gadachyo Jivana | sacho Ramko nam ||
Ajamil gunka tari | ham rank keto ek kam ||83||
Gaj grah gunka tari | Ajamil lino par ||
charane Ahalya odhari | so Jivan pran adhar ||84||
Mata Kaushalya Devaki | Yashoda-nandan Kahan ||
so sain hamare Jivana | je Kali mardyo man ||85||
Tan man varun Jivana | jahan Sitapatike das ||
charan kamal man unmuni | jagse rahe udas ||86||
Sutapa Prishni tap kiyo | dharyo Haripe dhyan ||
so sain hamare Jivana | akhand ras vardan ||87||
Swarath take Jivana | taki pure ash ||
van swarath bhakti kare | Raghupati take das ||88||
Aisa koi na mile Jivana | je milkar kije vat ||
apa de uthayke | upar lagave lat ||89||
Bhayo bhayankar danava | dharyo Narsinh avtar ||
bhagat Prahlad raksha kari | Jivan jug jejekar ||90||
Mar karun tuk tuklun | jyun Hiranyakashipu nakhyo phar ||
e birad hamare Jivana | nahi to lage mohe gar ||91||
Prahlad rakshakun Jivana | kachhu apne man vichar ||
abke santan shikh yon | je pani paheli par ||92||
Prahlad sankasht bhayo Jivana | tab bhai mohe dhil ||
ab chitvat pahele marhun | yun kahat hai Raghuvir ||93||
Dhanush ban dhare rahe | sab santanke kaj ||
Jivan man lalcha bhai | kachhu shravane suni avaj ||94||
Jan rakshakun Jivana | Raghupatike do vir ||
Anjani sut aur Lakshman | prabhu thadhe ap sharir ||95||
Jan rakshakun Jivana | Hari dhare dase avtar ||
ab hal musal Haldhar liye | Garud chadhe Gopal ||96||
Raksha karo Raghuvir dhir | Anjani sutke Ish ||
jan Jivanki vinati | tum suniyo Jagdish ||97||
Parcha payo Jivana | sacha Ramka nam ||
Ajamil gunika tari | to aur parcha kon kam ||98||
Parcha Parbrahm namka | Sadguru diya batay ||
aur parcha sab Jivana | phasphus hoy jay ||99||
Kahuke man Hari base | kahuke Shiv Hanuman ||
hamare man Jivana | Das Kabir nij nam ||100||
Manu payo paiso | Sitapatiko nam ||
kharchat hi khute nahi | Jivan jug bekam ||101||
Dharanidhar adhar rahyo | Balidvare adhin ||
Indre kaha diyo Jivana | Bali kaha liyo chhin ||102||
Dharanidhar adhar rahyo | Bali dvare adhin ||
sarvas arpyo Jivana | Hari bhaye lolin ||103||
So gali Shishupal dai | chakra katachyo tab shish ||
tej samano apmen | so jan Jivanke Ish ||104||
Hoti ai Jivana | so hosi nirdhar ||
Dhruv Prahlade je bhajyo | so moko pran adhar ||105||
Kali mardyo Kahanve | Indra utaryun man ||
Ravan dash shir chhede Jivana | soi hamare Ram ||106||
Kab Raghupati kab Yadupati | kab Shesh sukhasan dham ||
ek rup sab Jivana | pan jude jude nam ||107||
So sain hamara Ramji | je nathyo Kalinag ||
ta charansun Jivana | sada rahun so bhag ||108||
Dekh tamaso Jivana | bale kiyo kam ||
badhik kaha sukrit kiyo | kaha bal chalyo haram ||109||
Ajamil apradhi ek | gunka kiyo ghar vas ||
aisi bohot ki Jivana | pan Ram charanki ash ||110||
Ajamil gunka tari | so Jivan hamare Ram ||
charane Ahalya odhari | je sagarsutako dham ||111||
Sakh shabd tum det ho | dhiraj nahi man manhi ||
itni binati Jivana | tum suniyo hirde manhi ||112||
Anjanisutke Ish par | jan Jivan bali jay ||
vat ghat raksha karo | aise Raghupati ray ||113||
So sain hamare Jivana | Raghukul Yadukul vir ||
Saraju tire khelke | ayo Kalindi tir ||114||
Mule mithun mahelvane | kopyo bhekh anant ||
tun jin par darpe Jivana | shir par Kamalakanth ||115||
Man gayo jab male Jivana | Hariko nam rude dharo ||
apo tharhar kampiyo | tab ravisut to rito padachyo ||116||
Garud chhandi main Jivana | dhayo gajki vahar ||
ab shankh chakra Baldev sun | Garud vahan sant dvar ||117||
Harijan upar Jivana | mero jiv karun kurban ||
murakh man samjhe nahi | ganat vahalanki han ||118||
Samran Sitaramko | je kije so labh ||
bahuri na paiye Jivana | manav janamko dav ||119||
Main shankh chakra dharyo Jivana | so apne janke kaj ||
e birad kaise chhand hun | yun kahat hai Brijraj ||120||
Jaman jati ke birpar | jiv karun kurban ||
Vedokun sadka diya | so Jivan nam Rahman ||121||
Ja charan kamal barshata | sada prem prakash ||
Sitapatike das par | bali bali Jivandas ||122||
Lanka balyo satorane | bal na vanko thay ||
Anjani sutke Jivana | Raghupati sada sahay ||123||
Varah varu dhar dhara | vasudha kidhi thar ||
daitya sankashtthi chhodavi | so Jivan pran adhar ||124||

|| Iti Shri Daska Ang ||3||
|| Iti Shri dvitiya vishram sampurna ||
translation:
64. Among ragas, Sarang is the crown; among scriptures, the dhol (hymn-song) is the crown; among devotees, Jivana, the crown is he in whom is revealed the cowherd of Braj.

65. Among ragas Sarang is the crown, among the Vedas Shyam (the dark Lord) is the crown; among the forms of Krishna, Radhika is the crown - she who appeared in the village of Gokul.

|| Sakhi bhetki - couplets of the meeting ||

66. [unclear: "bamb bahro"] outside, Jivana - by wavering no work is accomplished. Either the rule of Kabirji, the servant who spun the wheel, or the rule of Padmanabh (the Lord).

|| Sakhi Shri Mukhki - couplets from the Lord's own mouth ||

67. For Devahuti's sake, Jivana, I became the incarnation of the sage Kapil; for Yadu I became Dattatreya - I, Padmanabh, the lord of riches.

68. Each recognized his own, Jivana - Padmanabh, the lord of riches. Master and servant met, and the work of the devotees was accomplished.

69. I am in the Ocean of Milk, Jivana, but my mind is in Gokul. Grieved by separation from my devotees I became sorrowful, for there no such devotee comes.

70. I am in the Ocean of Milk, Jivana, and for a long while I remain listless - my joy is in the bowers of Vrindavan, in the company of Radha.

71. I am a sacrifice to that woman who called me into Gokul. As the Bansi-bat (the banyan of the flute) is, Jivana, no other banyan's leaf is its equal.

72. In Vrindavan, Jivana, Raghuvir is in every single leaf. For many days he stayed hungry and then came to the bank of the Kalindi (Yamuna).

73. I was in Ayodhya, Jivana, but my mind was in Gokul; I had given my word to the sages' wives, and I do not forget that pledge of mine.

74. Leaving Ayodhya desolate, he came to the little village of Gokul. That is our Lord, Jivana - the Ram who slew Ravan.

75. The One became infinite and spread himself out, for love of his devotees - Raghuvir. For many days he stayed hungry and then came to the bank of the Kalindi.

76. The One became infinite and spread himself out, for love of his devotees - Raghuvir. He increased love, Jivana, on the bank of the Kalindi.

77. Now I shall do this, Jivana, holding the saints' word as authority: I shall be born as Nishkalank (the stainless one) and deliver all four orders of living beings.

|| Sakhi bhetki - couplets of the meeting ||

78. Serve the saints royally; the formless Name is the support. For love of his devotees, Jivana, Raghupati took incarnation.

|| Sakhi Shri Mukhki - couplets from the Lord's own mouth ||

79. Of the Raghu line and of the Yadu line, Jivana - the husband of Sita and the beloved of Radha - that Lord stands over our head, and his names are endless.

80. To abandon Sitapati Raghunath and take another's name - what other deed is there, Jivana, that would not give you a place in hell?

81. I offer my head as a sacrifice, Jivana, wherever the Lord's dear one is: he pardons the creature's fault and in an instant makes him blessed.

82. Fall into the path, Jivana, wherever the servants of Hari go out: stay in their company or let them take you along, and the heart's longing will be fulfilled.

83. The banner has been planted, Jivana - the true Name of Ram. It ferried Ajamil and the courtesan across; for us poor ones, then, how great a task can it be?

84. The elephant, the crocodile and the courtesan were ferried across, and Ajamil was carried over; by his feet Ahalya was redeemed - he is the support of Jivan's life-breath.

85. Son of mother Kaushalya, of Devaki, the delight of Yashoda - Kahan (Krishna); that is our Lord, Jivana - he who crushed the pride of Kali (the serpent Kaliya).

86. I give away body and mind, Jivana, wherever the servants of Sitapati are: with the mind absorbed in his lotus feet, they remain detached from the world.

87. Sutapa and Prishni performed austerity and fixed their meditation on Hari; that is our Lord, Jivana, who granted the boon of the unbroken ras (divine dance).

88. He fulfils the hope of the one who comes with self-interest, Jivana; but for the one who does bhakti (devotion) without self-interest, Raghupati becomes his servant.

89. No such one is met with, Jivana, with whom, on meeting, one might speak heart to heart - one who surrenders the ego, lifts it up and kicks it away.

90. When the demon grew terrible, he took the incarnation of Narsinh (the man-lion); he protected the devotee Prahlad - Jivana, hail to him through the ages.

91. I shall strike and tear him to pieces, as I ripped Hiranyakashipu apart; this is my sworn vow, Jivana - otherwise reproach would fall upon me.

92. To protect Prahlad, Jivana, consider a little in your own mind. Now this is the lesson taken for the saints' sake: [build] the embankment before the water comes.

93. Prahlad came into distress, Jivana, because there was delay on my part; now, says Raghuvir, I shall strike even before the enemy conceives the thought.

94. He stands holding bow and arrow, for the sake of all the saints. Jivana, my heart was drawn with longing when I heard some sound of it with my ears.

95. For the protection of his devotees, Jivana, Raghupati has two heroes - Anjani's son (Hanuman) and Lakshman - and the Lord himself stands there in person.

96. For the protection of his devotees, Jivana, Hari assumes the ten incarnations; now Haldhar (Balram) has taken up plough and pestle, and Gopal rides upon Garud.

97. Protect us, steadfast Raghuvir, lord of Anjani's son; this is the prayer of your servant Jivan - hear it, Lord of the world.

98. I have obtained the proof, Jivana - the true Name of Ram. It ferried Ajamil and the courtesan across; what use, then, is any other proof?

99. The proof of the Name of Parbrahm (the supreme Brahman) the Sadguru pointed out to me; every other proof, Jivana, crumbles away to nothing.

100. In some hearts Hari dwells, in some Shiv or Hanuman; in our heart, Jivana, dwells Das Kabir - that is our very own Name.

101. I count that I have found the wealth: the Name of Sitapati. Spending it, it is never exhausted - Jivana, all the world's other wealth is useless.

102. The upholder of the earth remained suspended, bound at Bali's door. What did Indra give, Jivana, and what did Bali take away by force?

103. The upholder of the earth remained suspended, bound at Bali's door. Bali offered up his all, Jivana, and Hari became absorbed in him.

104. When Shishupal hurled abuse, the discus then cut off his head; his light was absorbed into the Lord himself - he is the Lord of Jivan, his servant.

105. What has always been, Jivana, that surely shall be. The One whom Dhruv and Prahlad worshipped is the support of my life-breath.

106. Kahan (Krishna) crushed Kali (Kaliya) and brought down the pride of Indra; he severed Ravan's ten heads, Jivana - that very One is our Ram.

107. Sometimes Raghupati, sometimes Yadupati, sometimes the One resting on the couch of Shesh: all are one form, Jivana, only the names are different.

108. That Lord of ours is Ramji, who subdued the serpent Kali (Kaliya); may I always have the fortune, Jivana, of staying at his feet.

109. Behold the marvel, Jivana - the deed was done all the same. What merit had the hunter earned? [unclear: "kaha bal chalyo haram"].

110. Ajamil was a single great offender; he made his home with a courtesan. He committed many such deeds, Jivana - yet he had hope in the feet of Ram.

111. Ajamil and the courtesan were ferried across - he, Jivana, is our Ram; by his feet Ahalya was redeemed - he who is the abode of the ocean's daughter (Lakshmi).

112. You give me the word of your testimony, but there is no patience in my mind; this much is my prayer, Jivana - hear it within your heart.

113. Your servant Jivan is a sacrifice to the lord of Anjani's son; guard me on the road and at the landing-place, O king Raghupati.

114. That Lord of ours, Jivana, is the hero of the Raghu line and of the Yadu line; having played on the bank of the Saraju (Sarayu), he came to the bank of the Kalindi.

115. Countless disguised ones have raged, wanting to lay salt at your very root; but do not be afraid of them, Jivana - Kamalakanth (Lakshmi's lord) stands over your head.

116. Pride departs when one meets him, Jivana - hold Hari's Name in the heart. The ego shuddered and trembled, and then the Sun's son (Yam, death) was left empty-handed.

117. I abandoned Garud, Jivana, and ran to the rescue of the elephant; now, with conch, discus and Baldev, Garud my mount stands at the saints' door.

118. For the sake of Hari's devotees, Jivana, I would offer my life in sacrifice; the foolish mind does not understand, and reckons it a loss to its own dear ones.

119. The remembrance of Sitaram - whatever of it is done, that alone is profit; this chance of human birth, Jivana, will not be got again.

120. I have taken up conch and discus, Jivana, for the sake of my own devotees; how could I ever abandon this sworn vow? - so says Brijraj (the Lord of Braj).

121. I offer my life in sacrifice to the hero of the Jaman (Yavan) people; the Vedas were given up as an offering to him - that One, Jivana, bears the name Rahman.

122. From whose lotus feet there rains down always the light of love - to the servants of Sitapati, Jivandas is a sacrifice again and again.

123. Lanka was burnt together with its arched gateways, and not a hair of him was harmed; for Anjani's son, Jivana, Raghupati is always the helper.

124. Varaha lifted the earth upon his tusk and set the world at rest; he freed her from the torment of the demon - he is the support of Jivan's life-breath.

|| Here ends the Das ka Ang (the Canto of the Servant) ||3||
|| Here ends the Second Vishram (Resting-place), complete ||
